sections.title: Unlimited-supply vendor arbitrage
sections.description: Exact coin cost plus a documented convenience margin. These are route-and-faction arbitrage items, not scarcity plays.

sections.title: Limited-supply vendor arbitrage
sections.description: True stock caps and restock timers are verified separately from unlimited vendors.

sections.title: Token and reputation vendors
sections.description: The token requirement is exact; the gold band is a fallback estimate because time-gated currency has no deterministic gold conversion.

sections.title: Crafted companions
sections.description: Tradeable Engineering companions that do not require Engineering to use, with exact recipe floors and collectible-demand estimates.

sections.title: Crafted mounts — no profession required
sections.description: The finished motorcycles do not require Engineering to use; normal faction and Riding 150 requirements still apply.

sections.title: Crafted mounts — profession required
sections.description: The buyer must have the listed Engineering or Tailoring rank to use these finished flying mounts.

sections.title: Farmed companion drops
sections.description: Pinned loot routes, wide fallback bands, and one-at-a-time posting for thin collector demand.

sections.title: Quest-reward companions
sections.description: Tradeable quest-chain rewards whose acquisition route is verified independently of their price.

sections.title: Promotional and TCG mounts
sections.description: Only mounts with a pinned Landro's Gift Box route are included. Other technically tradeable promo mounts remain excluded pending server-availability proof.

sections.title: Shadowmourne quest rewards
